translations.web: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”
translations.bsb: Why are you asking Me? Ask those who heard My message. Surely they know what I said.”
translations.kjv: Why askest thou me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said.
translations.asv: Why askest thou me? Ask them that have heard me, what I spake unto them: behold, these know the things which I said.
